title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai .

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join ExTrac's engineering team to help build and operate the services and pipelines the platform runs on.

ExTrac takes a continuously ingested, multi-source corpus and turns it into products analysts use to make decisions under time pressure. You will be responsible for building and running the backend microservices that make that possible: services and databases that expose curated data through APIs, run search and aggregation over large indices, hold application state, and keep the whole thing fast and correct as volume and customer count grow.

The work is broad by design. In a single quarter it spans API and service design, search and database performance, long-running data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and the deployment tooling underneath all of it. You will own services end to end across a Go and Python codebase, working alongside the AI team who build our analytical and agentic features, the frontend team who build the web and mobile interfaces, and the analysts and product managers who define what gets built.

What the job involves

Service design and delivery 

- Take an ambiguous problem, gather requirements, write a technical design, and ship to production with minimal oversight.

- Own services end to end, including consolidating or decommissioning what they replace.

- Contribute to and lead system design and architecture decisions.

- Design APIs used by both internal teams and customers, and hold them to clear contracts and sensible versioning as the number of consumers grows.

- Treat the storage layer as a design concern rather than an implementation detail: schema, indexing strategy, and access patterns. Establish clear access patterns and boundaries.

Production engineering 

- Develop Go and Python-based microservices to support data collection, processing, and querying.

- Hold services to production standards for latency, cost, and reliability, with the instrumentation in place to know when they are not meeting them.

- Build and operate high-throughput data streaming pipelines and work on improving scalability, robustness, and latency.

- Optimise databases and index performance where it is the constraint on product behaviour.

Working with analysts, product, and the ML team 

- Work directly with the analysts who use our products, turning what they hit in practice into changes in the system.

- Iterate quickly against a live stream of product requests, flagging where they collide with longer-horizon platform work.

- Partner with the AI and frontend teams to deliver cross-functional features, solving the engineering, performance, and reliability problems that sit outside of their scope.

- Improve the shared foundations other engineers depend on: deployment pipelines, service templates, observability, and the environments their work runs in.

You should apply if

- You have built and operated production backend systems. You will spend your time working on and owning Go and Python services, databases, and APIs, and you know the difference between something that works on a laptop and something that holds up under production load, latency, and cost.

- You can operate with a high degree of autonomy. You will be trusted to lead projects, make decisions, and drive outcomes. We work on open-ended problems with no established answer, and when the obvious approach fails you generate alternatives rather than stopping.

- You do not trust a change until you have measured it. Reaching for the profiler, the trace, or the metric is instinct rather than afterthought.

- You treat quality, security, and observability as engineering fundamentals rather than optional extras, and you make the case for addressing technical debt rather than living with it.

- You raise the bar for the engineers around you in ways they would recognise: pairing on problems outside your own project, leaving reviews people learn from, and writing things down for the next person.

- You want to work on things that matter. Our software sits underneath decisions taken by governments, defence organisations, and institutions operating where being wrong or late carries real consequences.

Where this role can take you

- Deepen your ownership. Strong performance means ownership over larger sections of the platform, more architectural say over how our services evolve, and more influence over which problems we take on.

- Breadth rather than a narrow track. The work follows the problem, which means service design one month and pipeline or infrastructure work the next. Engineers here have the opportunity to build depth across several areas rather than being funnelled into one.

- Progress without changing track. ExTrac values the IC and management paths equally: Staff Engineer and Engineering Manager sit at the same level, and taking on reports is not the price of progression.

Requirements

Due to the nature of our work and the clients we support, applicants must be eligible to obtain UK security clearance. We are currently only able to consider applicants who are nationals of a NATO member state, Australia, or New Zealand. 

- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to stand up production-grade services and experience owning features end to end.

- Proficiency in building microservices using Go or Python.

- Solid understanding of distributed systems, databases, and software engineering patterns.

- Experience with cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and with the CI/CD pipelines around them.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable writing clear technical documentation and discussing requirements with colleagues from engineering and the wider team.

- Breadth across the stack: improving deployment pipelines, understanding database behaviour, and a genuine interest in security engineering.

- An interest in how the product is actually used, and a willingness to take analyst feedback into requirements discussions rather than treating requirements as someone else's problem.

Desirable 

- Currently working with Go-based microservices.

- Experience with Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL.

- Experience with streaming or event-driven pipelines.

- Experience with feature flags and trunk-based development. Features land close to weekly, and individual deploys go out several times a day across several projects.

- Experience operating multi-tenant systems where data isolation is a hard requirement.

- Experience working in software for defence, government, or other compliance-constrained environments.

Interview Process

- Initial Intro Interview with Hiring Manager - 30 Minutes

- Technical Assessment - 1 hour

- Competency-based Interview - 1 hour

- Founder Interview - 30 Minutes

Benefits

- Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

- A generous benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions.

- Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme.

- £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

- 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.

- Flexible working. The team is typically in our central London office two days a week, and you are welcome to come in up to five.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. 

ExTrac AI is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing open role within our organisation. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position but all hiring decisions will be made by a member of our team.

description:
ABOUT US METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability 

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer. 

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.

YOUR MISSION - PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
- Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
- Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
- Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
- Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
- Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
- Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
- OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary

YOUR PROFILE - 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
- Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
- Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
- Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
- Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
- Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
- Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
- Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
- Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen

WHY JOIN US? - You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact

title: Working Student (m/f/d)​Indexing Platform
description:
Company Description Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.

Job Overview Solactive's Aggregate team owns the intraday calculation of our indices: consuming live price streams, applying calculation logic across a wide range of indices, and producing a continuous output stream of index ticks throughout the trading day. The core platform is built in Java and engineered around throughput, latency, and correctness under concurrency, while custom business integrations are built in Python. As a Working Student you join a small team and contribute real, production-bound code to both, working alongside senior engineers who review your work and coach you.

Your Tasks - Implement well-scoped features and fixes in the Java calculation platform, such as improvements to calculation components, price stream consumption, or index tick production
- Write unit, integration, and performance tests, including tests for concurrent code paths where ordering and timing matter
- Help investigate correctness or performance issues: reproduce them, narrow them down, and propose fixes with senior guidance
- Build and maintain Python integrations for business teams: connectors to the calculation platform, output adapters, validation checks, and small operational tools
- Contribute to monitoring and developer tooling that makes calculation behaviour observable and easier to reason about
- Take part in design and code reviews, ask questions, and document what you learn so the next person can pick it up faster

Your Profile - Enrolled student in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related field
- Strong Java fundamentals: object-oriented design, collections, generics, and comfort reading and writing idiomatic modern Java
- Solid grounding in core computer science: data structures, algorithms, and complexity, and in particular a working understanding of multithreading and concurrency (threads, synchronisation, memory visibility, races and deadlocks)
- Openness to Python: no prior experience needed, but willingness to pick it up for integration and tooling work alongside Java
- Familiarity with Git, the command line, and a testing mindset; interest in measuring performance rather than guessing at it
- Ability to work independently on a scoped task, ask for help early when stuck, and communicate clearly in writing
- Available for 15–20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks
- Interest in financial markets, market data, or index calculation is welcome but not required

Our Offer - Be part of the Solactive family an international FinTech environment with flat hierarchies, real ownership, and strong growth opportunities.
- Enjoy attractive benefits such as team events, Corporate Benefits access, a modern ergonomic office,free beverages and fruit.
- Work on a real, high-impact production platform and contribute to architectural improvements not just feature tickets.
- Gain hands-on experience with Java microservices, build systems, and dependency governance while collaborating with experienced engineers.
- Build practical backend engineering skills that directly support your long-term career development.

Support and grow the community

Collaborate across the company 

Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users

You’ve built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge

You create content that makes people want to open their code editor

You’re equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript

Experience creating technical content (written or video)

Bonus points if you have:

Prior experience in DevRel or open source

Have used (and loved) Supabase

Fully Remote

ESOP 

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

Tech Allowance

Health Benefits

Flexible Work

Professional Development

60+ countries

title: Atlassian Consultant (m/w/d) - Cloud Migration im Banking
description:
Welcome to TEAM XALT 

Wir sind XALT – Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner mit 100 % DevSecOps-DNA. Seit 2016 realisieren wir Enterprise-Projekte in den Bereichen ITSM, Social Intranets, Cloud-Infrastruktur und Identity Management und schaffen sichere, skalierbare und moderne Kollaborationsumgebungen – auch dort, wo Regulatorik und Informationssicherheit jedes Detail mitentscheiden. Zu unseren Kunden zählen Finanzmarktinfrastrukturen und große Enterprise-Organisationen in ganz Deutschland.

Wir glauben an Freiheit statt Mikromanagement, an Zusammenarbeit statt Hierarchiedenken und an Wirkung statt Titel. Bei uns übernehmen Menschen Verantwortung, bringen ihre Ideen ein und gestalten sowohl Kundenlösungen als auch die Weiterentwicklung von XALT aktiv mit.

Wenn du echte Verantwortung und spürbaren Impact in einer wachsenden Beratung suchst, wirst du dich bei uns wohlfühlen.

Warum gerade jetzt 

Atlassian stellt seine Data-Center-Produkte ein. Für Banken heißt das: Jira, Confluence und Jira Service Management müssen in die Cloud – als IT-Auslagerung unter DORA, MaRisk und EBA-Leitlinien, die vor Revision und Aufsicht bestehen muss. Genau diese Projekte machen wir. Und dafür suchen wir Verstärkung.

Aufgaben

Als Atlassian Consultant begleitest du Banken und Finanzdienstleister von der Plattformstrategie bis zum Go-live in der Cloud. Du verbindest Beratungsstärke mit Hands-on-Mentalität: Heute sprichst du mit CIO und CISO über das Zielbild, morgen mit dem Auslagerungsmanagement über die Exit-Strategie – und übermorgen konfigurierst du selbst das Berechtigungsschema.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Plattformstrategie: Du analysierst gewachsene Atlassian-Landschaften und entwickelst Zielbilder – Cloud vs. Hybrid, Instanzschnitt, Mandantentrennung, Governance- und Berechtigungskonzepte, Roadmap.

- Regulatorisch saubere Migration: Du bereitest Migrationen so auf, dass Informationssicherheit, Auslagerungsmanagement, Compliance und Datenschutz sie freigeben können – inkl. Risikoanalyse, Exit-Strategie, DORA-Informationsregister, Prüfrechte und Subdienstleister.

- Security & Compliance in der Cloud: Du setzt EU-Datenresidenz, SSO/SCIM mit Atlassian Guard, Audit-Logging, Verschlüsselungskonzepte, Rollentrennung (SoD) und Berechtigungsrezertifizierung um.

- Migrationsplanung & -durchführung: Cloud-Readiness-Assessment, App-Analyse und -Bereinigung, Wellen- und Cutover-Planung, Migration mit JCMA/CCMA – im Takt von Change-Freeze-Zeiten und Vier-Augen-Prinzip der Bank.

- Prüfungsfeste Dokumentation: Migrationsprotokolle, Datenintegritätsnachweise und Berechtigungskonzepte für Revision und Aufsicht.

- Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du moderierst Workshops mit Entscheidern und Kontrollfunktionen und übersetzt technische Optionen in fundierte Entscheidungsvorlagen.

- Best Practices: Du entwickelst unsere Migrationsplaybooks für regulierte Kunden weiter und machst das Team damit skalierbar.

Qualifikation

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Atlassian-Beratung oder -Administration im Enterprise-Umfeld.

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit mindestens einer komplexen Server-/Data-Center-→-Cloud-Migration.

- Projekterfahrung im Banking bzw. in der Finanzbranche – oder in einem vergleichbar regulierten Umfeld.

- Solides Verständnis von DORA, MaRisk/BAIT, EBA-Leitlinien zu Auslagerungen und DSGVO. Du musst kein Jurist sein, aber die Fragen der Compliance-Abteilung beantworten können.

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Jira, Confluence und Jira Service Management, idealerweise auch Atlassian Cloud Enterprise und Atlassian Guard.

- Hands-on-Mentalitä t: Du konfigurierst selbst und wartest nicht darauf, dass jemand anderes die Umsetzung übernimmt.

- Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

- Ein Plus: Atlassian-Zertifizierungen (oder die Motivation, diese zu erwerben), Erfahrung mit ISO 27001 oder IT-Revisionen, ITIL/ITSM, Scripting (Groovy, Python, REST).

Benefits

- Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit langfristiger Perspektive.

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten – mit Büros in München und Leipzig.

- Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen (AI, ITIL, ACP, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes und mehr).

- Moderne Ausstattung nach deinen Präferenzen (MacBook oder Windows).

- Als Platinum Partner tiefe Atlassian-Expertise im Haus – für jedes Spezialthema hast du Kolleg:innen an deiner Seite.

- Ein AI-first-Umfeld, in dem neue Arbeitsweisen nicht nur diskutiert, sondern gelebt werden.

- Flache Hierarchien und echte Verantwortung. Keine starre Rolle, in die du hineingepresst wirst – du gestaltest deine Verantwortung nach deinen Stärken und baust unser Banking-Geschäft aktiv mit auf.

- Freie Wahl der (AI-) Tools, die du in deinem Arbeitsalltag benötigst

Klingt nach deinen Skills und deiner Perspektive für einen nächsten Schritt?

Wir freuen uns auf darauf, dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam die Zukunft der Zusammenarbeit zu gestalten.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

About Anago 

At Anago, more than 55 colleagues have been making a daily impact on society for over 25 years. Our software helps public organisations plan better, prioritise more effectively, and deploy capacity efficiently — enabling faster decisions, more effective use of resources, and better responses to societal challenges. Think: faster procedures for asylum seekers, improved preventive healthcare, and better allocation of education budgets.

We have built a strong position in the Netherlands and are now actively expanding internationally, including into the United Kingdom. The coming years will be defined by scaling up, broadening our market presence, and further professionalising our commercial organisation.

At Anago, we work on impact — combining smart working with a warm, collaborative culture.

The Role 

We are already taking concrete steps to integrate AI applications into our products. As Senior AI Engineer you have end responsibility for designing, setting up and further developing Anago's AI platform. As a front-runner you hold a strategic vision on AI adoption within the organisation and you put the AI structure in place.

You build the foundation on which future AI, ML and LLM solutions within our organisation are developed, rolled out and managed. Because our software is used every day by public sector organisations, you steer on security, governance, continuity, cost efficiency and explainability. After all, AI functionality that supports decisions about people must be transparent, auditable and reliable. That is also your default way of building.

You help give direction to how AI is applied within Anago, showing technical leadership and taking the lead on further AI adoption within Anago and towards our customers. This is emphatically not a research role; you spend most of your time designing, building, rolling out and managing AI systems that are used in production every day.

Qualifications for Success 

- University (WO) level of education and thinking

- At least 7 years of experience in software engineering, of which at least 3 years with AI, ML or LLM solutions in production environments

- You live within a distance that makes being in the office in Den Bosch at least 50% of the time practical and sustainable over the long term

- Demonstrable experience designing, building and managing business-critical AI platforms or AI solutions at scale

- Experience with ML frameworks and MLOps tooling

- Experience with LLMOps tooling such as LangFuse, LangSmith, LangChain or similar

- Hands-on experience with cloud-native infrastructure and deployment, preferably Azure

- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and pipeline orchestration (e.g. Airflow)

- Strong programming skills (for example in Python) and experience with production environments

- Solid knowledge of software architecture, data structures, algorithms, API design and distributed systems

- A strong software engineering foundation with attention to testability, maintainability and code quality

- Experience with code reviews, automated testing, version control and modern software development processes

- Strong communication skills in English and Dutch (minimum B1)

- You take ownership of the solutions you build and feel responsible for the result in production

- You are able to translate technical complexity into practical solutions and clear choices

What can you expect from us? 

You will work in an organisation where substance, collaboration and long-term impact come first. We strongly believe in the possibilities of AI and are actively building an AI-first approach within our products and our organisation.

- A key role in the development of our AI platform

- A great deal of freedom and responsibility

- Direct impact on product, technology and organisation

- Working on AI solutions with social relevance

- Working in an ambitious and technically strong team

- Room for development, experimentation and innovation

- A fixed base salary between €5,291.59 and €7,559.41, depending on experience, knowledge and skills

- Net phone and internet allowance

- 8% holiday allowance

- 26 holiday days, with the option to buy 6 extra days or 13 ADV (reduced working hours) days

- Flexible working hours and the possibility to work hybrid; our office is located close to ’s-Hertogenbosch central station, where you can work flexible hours. In addition, the possibility to work from home with a fully equipped home workspace including a work-from-home allowance

- A non-contributory pension

- Top-up of paid parental and partner leave to 100%

- A delicious catered lunch at the office every day (for a small contribution)

- Regular team outings, drinks and activities, through which we regularly give something back to society

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Equal Employment Opportunity at Banyan: Banyan affirms that inequality is detrimental to our Global Teams, associates, our Operating Companies, and the communities we serve. As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Banyan is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status and will not discriminate against anyone on the basis of a disability. We support an inclusive workplace where associates excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance.

Please Note : Banyan Software does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications submitted via email, LinkedIn, or other direct channels. All candidates must apply through our official Careers site to be considered for employment. Applications submitted outside of our applicant tracking system will not be reviewed.

Recruitment Notice 

Banyan Software may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation.

Beware of Recruitment Scams 

We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. 

Protect yourself by following these steps: 

- Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware.com email address.

Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

title: Senior Geodesist
description:
Senior Geodesist 

This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens. 

About us 

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across Europe, South America, Africa and Australia. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, Innovate UK and the European Innovation Council.

Position Overview 

London · Full time · On-site

You'll lead our geodesy work. That means making sure our ranging data meets the standards of the international geodetic community, and turning it into products that scientists and operators trust.

What you'll do 

- Lead geodetic processing and analysis of our satellite laser ranging data

- Contribute to reference frame and Earth orientation products

- Define data quality standards, and validate our data against international analysis centres

- Represent Foundational in the ILRS, IAG and wider geodetic community

- Guide our data scientists and software engineers on models and algorithms

- Publish and present at conferences

What you'll bring 

- A PhD or equivalent experience in space geodesy or a related field

- Deep knowledge of SLR and at least one other space-geodetic technique (GNSS, VLBI or DORIS)

- Experience with reference frames (ITRF), Earth orientation and IERS conventions

- Experience with geodetic analysis software such as GEODYN, Bernese or GipsyX

- A publication record or equivalent track record

Nice to have 

- Experience at an ILRS analysis or data centre

- Gravity field modelling or precise orbit determination

- Python

What We Offer 

- A high-impact role with real ownership at an early-stage, venture-backed spacetech company

- EMI share options (UK employees)

- 25 Days Annual Leave + Bank Holidays

- Enhanced Parental Leave

- Cycle to work schemes

- Work alongside engineers and scientists across optics, lasers, software and astrodynamics

- Offices in central London, with snacks, tea, coffee and regular socials

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description:
About Us 

At TeamSnap , we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “ Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “ 100 Best Remote-First Places to Work." 

TeamSnap is seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Backend, to join our fully distributed engineering team and help us continue scaling systems that serve millions of daily users and tens of thousands of amateur sports organizations. Our stack includes Node, TypeScript, Elixir, Ruby/Rails, SQL, React, cloud-based services, event-driven systems, queues, background jobs, caching layers, and observability tooling.

We are looking for a hands-on Staff Backend Engineer who can build and improve APIs and services, reason through production issues across the system, lead technical design in ambiguous areas, mentor engineers, and raise the quality bar across the team. This person should be comfortable working closely with infrastructure, platform, and data teams without being expected to own those functions directly.

As an engineering team, we architect and build scalable systems using service-oriented and event-driven architecture. This role will help shape the technical foundation behind TeamSnap’s product experience, with a focus on backend systems, APIs, services, data performance, reliability, observability, and production quality.

What You'll Do:

- 
Architect, build, and evolve backend APIs, services, event-driven workflows, queues, background jobs, data models, caching strategies, and integrations that support millions of users and thousands of sports organizations.

- 
Own complex backend product and technical work from discovery through design, implementation, rollout, production support, and long term maintainability.

- 
Lead ambiguous technical initiatives by breaking down problems, identifying risks, making practical tradeoffs, and helping teams move from uncertainty to clear execution.

- 
Improve the reliability, scalability, performance, and operability of production systems through thoughtful architecture, strong testing practices, database optimization, caching, monitoring, alerting, and incident follow-up.

- 
Debug complex production issues by reasoning across application code, databases, caches, queues, jobs, observability data, and the broader request lifecycle.

- 
Partner with Product, Design, Engineering, Infrastructure, Platform, Data, Support, and other teams to turn roadmap needs into durable backend systems and practical delivery plans.

- 
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to give and receive constructive feedback, mentor engineers, influence cross-team alignment and articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

What Will Set You Up for Success:

- Strong Node expertise with experience building and maintaining production backend systems.

- 
Staff level backend engineering depth, with a strong track record building and operating high-scale APIs, services, distributed systems, or shared product capabilities in production.

- 
Strong command of backend technologies such as Node, TypeScript, Elixir, Ruby/Rails, Java, Go, Python, or similar, including runtime behavior, failure modes, and production tradeoffs.

- 
Strong SQL and relational database judgment, including indexing, query optimization, migrations, profiling, data modeling, transactions, read and write patterns, and performance tuning.

- 
Practical understanding of service-oriented architecture, event-driven architecture, queues, background jobs, webhooks, Redis or similar caching tools, and systems that need to scale under real production load.

- 
Working knowledge of production infrastructure and platform concerns, enough to reason through deployments, containers, CI/CD pipelines, cloud services, networking basics, observability, and operational debugging.

- 
Strong production ownership mindset, with the ability to use logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, incident reviews, and system behavior to improve reliability over time.

- 
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, mentor engineers, facilitate technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and connect backend technical choices to customer impact, business needs, and long term maintainability.

Bonus:

- 
Previous work in or close partnership with infrastructure, platform, SRE, DevOps, or data teams.

- 
Familiarity with Elasticsearch, BigQuery, analytics pipelines, search infrastructure, reporting workflows, or high-volume data processing.

- 
Responsible use of AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve debugging, testing, documentation, refactoring, prototyping, or developer experience without compromising quality or understanding.

Compensation

Additional Information

Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

Compensation 

We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $200,000 inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. 

Location 

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

Opportunities to Grow 

At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it.

Total Rewards 

• We're proud to be remote-first . We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool

• Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary)

• 100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family

• 401K to help you invest for the future

• $1,500 annual learning and development stipend 

• Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events

• Generous home office allowance to set you up for success

• TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter

• A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more!

• TeamSnap Total Rewards 

Working at TeamSnap 

At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit, you're a culture add. Check out our Culture Playbook and learn how we succeed at being remote-first, what makes our company so unique, and how we're inspired by our people, our customers, and our values.

Inclusion and Diversity 

Creativity and innovation can't thrive when we're cookie-cutter images of each other. We’re quickly growing more diverse, but there's always room for improvement. We are committed to inclusion and diversity at TeamSnap, and we hold ourselves accountable for building an environment where everyone feels valued. If you need any disability-related adaptation during the recruitment process, just let us know! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

title: QA Engineer
description:
At Workwize , we’re helping IT teams to easily equip their remote and global teams with all necessary IT equipment. Our automated SaaS platform simplifies hardware deployment, management, and retrieval with fast, reliable deliveries in 100+ countries.

With 50.000 users and 120.000 devices under management, we’re solving hybrid work challenges like laptop deliveries, returns and equipment tracking, allowing IT teams to focus less on manual hassles and more on strategic initiatives.

Join our team to help shape the future of global collaboration. At Workwize, your work will make a real impact in building smarter, more connected workplaces worldwide.

LinkedIn has also recognized Workwize as one of the Top 10 Startups for 2025 in the Netherlands!

If you’re a QA Engineer with a passion for optimizing systems, working with cutting-edge integrations, and enhancing user experiences, Workwize could be the perfect fit for you!

About the Role 

We’re looking for a skilled QA Engineer to enhance the quality of our established Workwize platform. Your mission will be to elevate system functionality, work closely with developers, and ensure robust integration testing. This role is perfect for someone eager to contribute to a high-quality, streamlined user experience.

In this role, you'll also be responsible for writing automated end-to-end tests using Cypress and Playwright, supporting the team in maintaining existing features, and actively contributing to the development of new ones. You’ll help drive a "shift-left" approach, ensuring that quality is embedded early in the development process and championing best practices that foster a culture of testing and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities 

Develop a Comprehensive QA Strategy:

- Create, document, and maintain a clear QA strategy that aligns with our operational goals and product roadmap.

- Promote a shift-left testing culture , ensuring quality considerations are embedded from the early stages of design and development.

- Collaborate with developers and product owners to ensure the strategy is well understood and consistently applied across all teams and codebases.

Collaboration and Continuous Improvement: 

- Work closely with developers throughout the SDLC to provide feedback on testability, code quality, and potential edge cases.

- Support the team in both maintaining existing features and ensuring high quality in the development of new features .

- Manage bugs, incidents, and root cause analysis efforts, while continuously improving quality practices and testing standards.

Testing and Automation:

- Design, implement, and maintain automated end-to-end and integration tests for our Laravel and React applications.

- Develop and manage API test suites to validate backend functionality, performance, and reliability.

- Leverage Cypress and Playwright to automate high-value test scenarios that reflect real-world user behavior.

- Continuously improve and scale our test automation infrastructure to accelerate development workflows and CI/CD pipelines.

Required Skills & Qualifications 

- 4+ years of experience as a QA Engineer or Software Tester.

- Experience with Automation Testing is non negotiable. 

- Strong knowledge of testing methodologies and tools

- Experience with Postman API testing suite and Cypress & Playwright.

- Familiarity with Javascript and PHP.

- Familiarity with Github Actions and CI/CD.

- Familiarity with AWS services is a plus.

The Right Mindset 

- Analytical mind with great attention to detail.

- Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Working location 

- Working hours according to Central European Time (CET)

- Based in Europe or South Africa, and hired remotely unless based in the Netherlands.

Workwize Offers 

- Flexible hybrid work environment.

- Top-notch tools and equipment provided.

- Vibrant, entrepreneurial culture with opportunities for growth.

- Off-sites and multi-yearly team bonding events.

- Team lunches and surprise events to keep things fun.

- Pension scheme. (Netherlands only).

- Classpass corporate membership (Netherlands only).

Our Team 

Becoming part of Workwize means making an impact. We make sure that we will contribute to the change in the way of working. For us it is also important that we make an impact on our employees, that they feel challenged and ease. We consist of a rapid growing and ambitious team with all different backgrounds. Entrepreneurs, Operational specialists, Developers, Sales gurus you can find them all at Workwize and are always on the look-out for the next original ideas to reach more consumers and create the best value for our customers. 

We are looking forward to meeting you and discover if there is a match with the Workwize team! 

Please note: For this role we are not offering relocation support or visa sponsorship.

title: Senior/ Lead AI Consultant
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team 

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role 

As a Senior/ Lead AI Consultant (known internally - Senior/ Lead Deployment Engineer), you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.

This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact. 

The Work You’ll Do 

Initiate and Connect 

- Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases

- Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria

- Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

Build & Value 

- Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements

- Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights

- Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer

- Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot

- Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies

- Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact

- Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

Rollout, Adoption, and Handover 

- Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption

- Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations

- Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value

- Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

Domain & Industry Depth 

- Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals

- Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage

- Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era 

- You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually

- You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly

- You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers

- You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer

- You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

The Qualifications You Need 

- Experience: 4-7+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. 

- Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.

- AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.

- Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.

- Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences. 

- Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.

- Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.

- Languages: Fluency in English required. Additional languages are a plus.

- Travel : Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us: 

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

title: Senior Software Engineer - (Home Energy)
description:
About Enode 

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

What we're looking for:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help build the software layer that makes home energy devices work as one system. The Home Energy team owns Enode's integrations and APIs for batteries, solar inverters, HVAC, and smart meters, along with the home energy management (HEM) system and statistics that customers build on. You'll build integrations with leading OEMs and help mature our API surface into the unified control layer for the home, at a moment when customer demand for battery and home energy optimization is accelerating.

You'll join the Home Energy team, reporting to the team's Engineering Manager. You'll collaborate closely with your PM, fellow backend engineers, and our partnership and commercial teams, from assessing OEM API feasibility to shaping how customers control energy assets through our platform.

In this role, you will:

- Build and maintain integrations with OEM cloud platforms across batteries, solar, smart meters, and HVAC.

- Design and evolve our home energy APIs, unifying telemetry and controls across HEM system, batteries, and curtailment into a product surface customers can build optimizations on.

- Improve observability and vendor performance across our integrations, and take part in the team's triage rotation.

- Work with partnership and commercial teams on API feasibility for new OEM integrations.

- Build strong relationships with the customers who rely on our platform, working alongside your PM and commercial partners, and let what you learn from them shape what we build.

- Debug and ship production features in Node/TypeScript on our AWS-based stack.

- Take a product-engineer mindset, balancing speed, quality, and customer impact in your day-to-day decisions.

Curious what you'd actually be building? Explore our API docs and the Enode Tech Blog to see what we ship and how we think about it.

This role will be right for you, if:

You're an ambitious backend engineer who likes to own things end to end: from an ambiguous problem, through design and integration work, to something shipped and running in production. You find integration challenges satisfying rather than frustrating, including working with third-party APIs of varying maturity, and you're energized by tough technical problems.

You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and bringing clarity and structure that help a team move forward. You collaborate naturally with engineers, PMs, and commercial partners, and you like being close enough to the product to influence where it goes.

Above all, you care about building software with real-world impact that supports the shift toward a cleaner, more flexible energy system. You bring: 

- Experience building and maintaining backend services in production, ideally in API or integration-heavy systems.

- Strong skills in designing for reliability, scalability, and performance.

- Ability to own work from initial scoping to production rollout, including iterating based on customer or usage insights.

- Comfort in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environments where teams create clarity together.

- Clear, thoughtful communication across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.

- A product mindset: you care about solving the right problem and making life easier for customers and teammates.

Nice to have:

- Experience with TypeScript/Node, AWS services, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or similar production tooling.

- Familiarity with home energy assets (batteries, solar/inverters, HVAC, smart meters), energy markets, or IoT/device ecosystems.

- Prior exposure to API-first products or integration platforms.

- On-call or incident response experience.

What we offer:

- Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.

- A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.

- Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.

- Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.

- Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand.

- Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places.

- Flexible, human-first culture.

- Stipend for setting up your home office.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A few things to note:

- Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

- Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here .

title: Backend Software Engineer
description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai .

The Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join ExTrac's engineering team to help build and operate the services and pipelines the platform runs on.

ExTrac takes a continuously ingested, multi-source corpus and turns it into products analysts use to make decisions under time pressure. You will help build and run the backend microservices that make that possible: services and databases that expose curated data through APIs, run search and aggregation over large indices, hold application state, and keep the whole thing fast and correct as volume and customer count grow.

The work is broad by design. In a single quarter it spans API and service design, search and database performance, long-running data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and the deployment tooling underneath all of it. You will own well-defined features and components end to end within a single system across a Go and Python codebase, working alongside the AI team who build our analytical and agentic features, the frontend team who build the web and mobile interfaces, and the analysts and product managers who define what gets built.

What the job involves 

Service design and delivery 

- Build and own features, components, and APIs end to end within a single system, taking responsibility for your work and its place within the overall architecture.

- Contribute to system design and architecture discussions, and take on more of the design work as you build context and scope.

- Build and maintain APIs used by internal teams and customers, following established contracts and versioning conventions.

Production engineering 

- Develop Go and Python-based microservices to support data collection, processing, and querying, with guidance from senior engineers on more complex components.

- Help hold services to production standards for latency, cost, and reliability, and build the instrumentation to know when they are not meeting them.

- Build and operate high-throughput data streaming pipelines and work on improving scalability, robustness, and latency.

- Help optimise databases and index performance where it is the constraint on product behaviour.

Working with analysts, product, and other engineering teams 

- Work directly with the analysts who use our products, turning what they hit in practice into changes in the system.

- Iterate quickly against a live stream of product requests, flagging where they collide with longer-horizon platform work.

- Partner with the AI and frontend teams to deliver cross-functional features, working through the engineering, performance, and reliability problems that sit outside of their scope.

- Contribute to the shared foundations other engineers depend on: deployment pipelines, service templates, observability, and the environments their work runs in.

You should apply if

- You have built and worked on production backend systems. You will spend your time working on Go and Python services, databases, and APIs, and you know the difference between something that works on a laptop and something that holds up under production load, latency, and cost.

- You can work independently on well-defined problems, and know when to flag ambiguity or ask for input rather than guessing. When the obvious approach fails, you look for another one before escalating.

- You are happy to take the initiative in order to complete a task, whether that means learning a new skill, reaching out to stakeholders to clarify requirements, or suggesting an alternate approach.

- You treat quality, security, and observability as engineering fundamentals rather than optional extras, and you flag technical debt rather than letting it accumulate silently.

- You actively seek feedback and act on it, and you look for opportunities to pair with and learn from the engineers around you.

- You want to work on things that matter. Our software sits underneath decisions taken by governments, defence organisations, and institutions operating where being wrong or late carries real consequences.

Where this role can take you 

- Deepen your ownership. Strong performance means ownership over larger sections of the platform, more architectural say over how our services evolve, and more influence over which problems we take on.

- Breadth rather than a narrow track. The work follows the problem, which means service design one month and pipeline or infrastructure work the next. Engineers here have the opportunity to build depth across several areas rather than being funnelled into one.

- Progression based on impact. Progress by taking on bigger problems. What moves you to Senior here is the scope you can own end to end and the judgement you show when the answer isn't obvious, not time served.

Requirements 

Due to the nature of our work and the clients we support, applicants must be eligible to obtain UK security clearance. We are currently only able to consider applicants who are nationals of a NATO member state, Australia, or New Zealand. 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade services, and experience owning features or components end to end within a larger system.

- Proficiency in building microservices using Go or Python, with the ability to pick up the other quickly.

- Practical understanding of software engineering patterns.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable writing clear technical documentation and discussing requirements with colleagues from engineering and the wider team.

- Interest across the stack: an interest in deployment pipelines, database behaviour, and security engineering.

- An interest in how the product is actually used, and a willingness to take analyst feedback into requirements discussions rather than treating requirements as someone else's problem.

Desirable 

- Currently working with Go-based microservices.

- Experience with Elasticsearch and/or PostgreSQL.

- Experience with cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and with the CI/CD pipelines around them.

- Experience with streaming or event-driven pipelines.

- Experience with feature flags and trunk-based development. Features land close to weekly, and individual deploys go out several times a day across several projects.

- Experience working in software for defence, government, or other compliance-constrained environments.

Interview Process 

- Initial Intro Interview with Hiring Manager - 30 Minutes

- Technical Assessment - 1 hour

- Competency-based Interview - 1 hour

- Founder interview - 30 Minutes

Benefits 

- Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

- A generous benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions.

- Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme.

- £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

- 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.

- Flexible working, with the opportunity to spend up to 3 days a week remotely alongside regular days with our team in our central London office.

ExTrac AI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. 

ExTrac AI is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing open role within our organisation. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position but all hiring decisions will be made by a member of our team. 

Compensation: £75K – £80K
